Lean.addAndCompile.fullDefinition: def addAndCompile (decl : Declaration) : CoreM Unit := do   addDecl decl   compileDecl decl
Lean.addAndCompile.description: A function that adds a declaration to a context and compiles it.

Lean.addDecl.fullDefinition: def addDecl (decl : Declaration) : CoreM Unit := do   profileitM Exception "type checking" (← getOptions) do     withTraceNode `Kernel (fun _ => return m!"typechecking declaration") do       if !(← MonadLog.hasErrors) && decl.hasSorry then         logWarning "declaration uses 'sorry'"       match (← getEnv).addDecl (← getOptions) decl (← read).cancelTk? with       | .ok    env => setEnv env       | .error ex  => throwKernelException ex
Lean.addDecl.description: A function that adds a declaration to a context.
